summary: Original public runx skill example repo created under elevasyncsolutions-jpg: a portable SKILL.md contract wrapping the live CryptoBoss multi-source price API, with README, usage instructions, and a captured live API response as proof the underlying service works.
audience: Future runx contributors and agent developers looking for a minimal, real, read-only example of the portable skill contract (frontmatter, when-to-use, inputs, procedure, output, safety rules, success criteria).
why_allowed: The repo is an original public example that mentions runx (README links to https://runx.ai and https://github.com/runxhq/runx), lives on a public venue where project sharing is allowed, and is useful to a maintainer or future contributor as a copyable skill pattern.
observations: runx_link_found: true (README and SKILL.md link to https://github.com/runxhq/runx and https://runx.ai)
Repo created and pushed at github.com/elevasyncsolutions-jpg/runx-crypto-price-skill (public, reachable by any stranger, no auth required)
SKILL.md follows the runx portable skill contract: frontmatter with name/description/runx tags/links/license, when-to-use, inputs, procedure, output format, safety rules, and success criteria
Skill is read-only by design: no API keys, no writes, no signing; authority bounded to a single GET request per runx doctrine
Live proof captured during build: GET https://cryptoboss.space/api/price?coins=bitcoin,ethereum returned HTTP 200 with BTC $64304.5 and ETH $1906.32 from source kraken
Provenance commit b7a7c4094dfa722709925a73dc73fa3a6178c5e8; artifacts: SKILL.md, README.md, report.md, evidence.json
